definitions.explanation: a research paper or thesis required for graduation from a university undergraduate program

examples.japanese: {卒論|そつろん}のテーマが{決|き}まらない。
examples.english: I can't decide on a topic for my thesis.

examples.japanese: {卒論|そつろん}の{締|し}め{切|き}りに{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせるために{徹夜|てつや}した。
examples.english: I pulled an all-nighter to meet the thesis deadline.

notes:
ABBREVIATION:
{卒論|そつろん} is an abbreviation of {卒業論文|そつぎょうろんぶん}.

RELATED TERMS:
- {修論|しゅうろん} - master's thesis ({修士論文|しゅうしろんぶん})
- {博論|はくろん} - doctoral dissertation ({博士論文|はくしろんぶん})
- {指導教官|しどうきょうかん} - thesis advisor
- ゼミ - seminar (where thesis work is supervised)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卒論|そつろん}を{書|か}く - write a thesis
- {卒論|そつろん}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する - submit a thesis
- {卒論|そつろん}の{発表|はっぴょう} - thesis presentation
- {卒論|そつろん}に{追|お}われる - be pressed by thesis work
